items: CAND-2026-06-12-A91C37E5 — HarnessX reports large cross-benchmark gains from evolving typed agent harnesses, creating a useful contrast with HARNESSEVO's localized-credit result — revisit if: Independent reproduction appears, a paper-tagged release or exact benchmark/evolution manifests are published, or matched controls separate model/backbone, harness composition, adaptation compute, verifier leakage and component-level credit.

CAND-2026-07-15-CHINA-ANTHROPOMORPHIC-AI-RULES — China's dedicated anthropomorphic-AI interaction rules enter force with dependency, manipulation and minor-protection duties — revisit if: CAC or other agencies publish enforcement cases, implementing standards, safety-assessment guidance, filing data or interpretations affecting agent memory/personalization/autonomy.

CAND-2026-08-02-EU-AI-ACT-ENFORCEMENT — EU AI Act enters an enforcement phase for GPAI and transparency obligations — revisit if: Commission enforcement actions, GPAI guidance updates, Code-of-Practice implementation evidence, complaints/decisions or material court/regulator interpretations appear.

CAND-2026-08-02-EU-GPAI-ENFORCEMENT — European Commission enforcement powers for general-purpose AI model obligations enter application — revisit if: The Commission announces a first GPAI enforcement action, systemic-risk notification decision, serious-incident proceeding, fine, or material interpretive update.

CAND-2026-08-18-FDA-GENAI-MEDICAL-DEVICES — FDA opens competency-based regulatory framework discussion for generative-AI medical devices — revisit if: FDA publishes docket comments, workshop material, draft/final guidance, legal-authority analysis or concrete submission expectations before the deadline.

CAND-2026-08-26-ANTHROPIC-CVD-SCALE — Anthropic's disclosure ledger shows AI-assisted vulnerability discovery scaling to thousands of human-reviewed findings — revisit if: The dashboard materially changes, per-model discovery attribution/cost is released, or independent organizations publish matched AI-versus-human vulnerability-discovery throughput.

CAND-2026-08-26-AWS-NVIDIA-2M-GPU-EXPANSION — AWS and NVIDIA plan 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra/Rubin-class GPUs across 2027–2028 — revisit if: AWS discloses installed/deployed counts, Rubin instances reach GA, procurement/power buildout data appears, or timelines materially change.

CAND-2026-08-31-3C91A8D4 — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act — revisit if: The Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadline, systemic-risk requirements, audit/researcher-access details, enforcement actions or OpenAI implementation changes.

CAND-2026-08-31-4F2C8E11 — EuroHPC signs €387.8M AMD MI430X LUMI-AI contract for 2027 deployment — revisit if: EuroHPC/CSC publish accelerator counts, peak/sustained AI performance, access policy or deployment milestones; installation begins; or the contract/system architecture materially changes.

CAND-2026-08-31-54C150C8 — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider cultivation action — revisit if: MIIT publishes the national resource pool, procurement/compute-support figures, standards, adoption results, provider lists, or measurable model/agent deployment outcomes.

CAND-2026-08-31-5BE9E260 — Signal: draft IPO documents reportedly show a $5.5B OpenAI warrant position in SB Energy as AI infrastructure financing deepens — revisit if: SB Energy IPO filing, SEC document, OpenAI/SoftBank/NVIDIA statement, audited financing document, or additional independent reporting confirms or contradicts the warrant and guarantee details.

CAND-2026-08-31-A11F0A7E — Maniformer reports a million-hour multimodal human-interaction corpus and 20,000-device collection fleet for Physical AI — revisit if: Public dataset slices, model/data cards, independent quality audits, VLA scaling curves, privacy/consent documentation, customer training results or cross-embodiment transfer measurements appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-A1C3550A — HUMAIN puts AMD MI355X/Cisco AI infrastructure into production in Saudi Arabia and targets a much larger sovereign compute buildout — revisit if: Installed accelerator count, power draw, acceptance benchmark, pricing, customer workload metrics, independent utilization data, MI400 phase commissioning, or sovereign-AI procurement documents appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-AGENT-CAPABILITY-COST-EVAL — Agent capability-cost evaluation: cheaper failure is not a Pareto win, and run provenance is load-bearing — revisit if: A larger attempt-linked dataset, repeated trials, pinned model/tool configurations or independent harness comparisons appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-C43E30F0 — China's Intelligent Chemical Model 3.0 Pro moves a vertical model toward tool-executing chemical-engineering workflows — revisit if: Technical report, benchmark protocol, model/data card, reproducible agent tasks, pilot-plant closed-loop results, safety/audit details or independent industrial evaluation appears.

CAND-2026-08-31-CHINA-NATIONAL-AI-COMPUTE-SCALE — China reports 2.45 million PFLOPS FP16 of national intelligent-compute capacity and expanding centralized scheduling — revisit if: National Data Administration publishes methodology, accelerator inventory/utilization, energy data, task-level scheduling statistics, or independent capacity estimates suitable for cross-country comparison.
CAND-2026-08-31-CN-AI-APPLICATION-SERVICE-PROVIDERS — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider program with explicit demand-side procurement support — revisit if: new evidence

CAND-2026-08-31-CONFIDENCE-CHANNEL-DIVERGENCE — Linguistic confidence is a lossy and poorly calibrated channel for internal model confidence — revisit if: Independent reproduction, stronger black-box calibration methods, or adaptive-compute/agent-routing studies compare verbal confidence against internal or ensemble uncertainty at matched cost.

CAND-2026-08-31-CXMT-HBM4-SIGNAL — Signal: CXMT reportedly begins small-scale HBM4 production — revisit if: CXMT or a named customer confirms HBM4 shipments/specifications, teardown/benchmark evidence appears, packaging partners disclose volume, or multiple independent sources corroborate yield and scale.

CAND-2026-08-31-EU-CHATGPT-VLOSE — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA — revisit if: Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadlines, systemic-risk assessment, audit requirements, data-access measures, enforcement action or OpenAI implementation details.
